name: Video Capture
author: Chris Pinkham (CaptainMurdoch)
description: Capture Video from Linux V4L2 device and insert into channel data

privacy.summary: Shows a camera picture on your matrix without recording it. Connects only to the camera address you enter. Sends nothing about you or the picture online.

sends.to: http://the network camera address you enter
sends.what: a request to open the camera's video stream, with any user name and password in the address
sends.why: to show that camera's live picture on your matrix

privacy.other: When a network camera stream starts, the full address you entered, including any user name and password you put in it, is printed to the system journal (journalctl -u fppd), which FPP's troubleshooting page can show. Nothing is captured until you run a Video Capture effect from a playlist or the Effects page. Install fetches the video libraries it needs (libv4l, v4l-utils, ffmpeg libavformat/libavcodec/libswscale) from Debian's standard repository with apt.
